title: Federal Rule 18 — joinder of claims
summary: Claim joinder allows a party to assert more than one claim against an existing opposing party. Federal Rule 18 provides broad procedural permission even when claims differ in subject or legal theory.

sections.Role in the course: Claim joinder allows a party to assert more than one claim against an existing opposing party. Federal Rule 18 provides broad procedural permission even when claims differ in subject or legal theory.
sections.What to examine: Identify the existing opposing-party relationship and each proposed claim. Then test jurisdiction and other independent requirements. A court can separate matters for fair or efficient trial even though they may be pleaded together.
